data.one_liner: Real‑time internet speed monitor for Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: Provides a stream that emits current download/upload speed in kbps or Mbps. It uses Android permissions for network state and internet access.
use_when: You need to display real‑time bandwidth to users
You want a lightweight plugin without heavy dependencies
You prefer a simple stream API over polling
avoid_when: You need cross‑platform support beyond Android
You require advanced network diagnostics or packet capture
You already use a comprehensive networking library that includes speed metrics
strengths: Supports both kbps and Mbps units
weaknesses: No unit tests or CI info
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, add INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions to AndroidManifest.xml
